units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>מהו דתימא בקְפִידַת הבעל וכ׳</he> you may have thought that the Scripture makes the case dependent on the husband’s objection, and the husband shows here that he does object (to her conduct); <cite ref="Sotah 26b:16">Sot. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>בקפידא דבעל</he> (Chald.).
